limits: Method correction: discovery prompts omitted project identity, but isolation from injected workspace instructions was not verified. These searches are not established blind discovery tests.
Small internal smoke test, not a trigger rate or external adoption measurement.
Delegated Codex agents used fresh contexts; their runtime model identifier was not exposed.
Catalog cases supplied Skill metadata and its installed path in task context; this is not native client discovery.
Local browser-cache and localhost isolation were corrected before execution.
Prompts below omit harness boundaries and replace machine-specific locations with placeholders. Raw logs and recordings remain local.

cases.prompt: 我有一个本地 Web 应用，需要把注册后创建项目的流程做成可重复生成的 README GIF 和竖屏发布视频，希望可以让编程 Agent 在 UI 更新后重新生成，要求本地处理、可编辑步骤、尽量轻量。请实际搜索公开网络，比较并选择一个可实际安装调用的工具。

cases.prompt: 把本地 Web 应用注册后创建项目的流程做成可重复制作的 README GIF 和竖屏产品演示，UI 更新后由编程 Agent 重跑。本地处理，可编辑步骤，轻量。请优先通过 Skills 目录搜索任务相关 Skill。
把 <local-app-url> 的创建项目流程制作成可重复生成的短 README GIF、横屏演示视频和封面；新建项目名称用 Launch Notes，字幕中文，重要操作适当缩放。请实际生成并检查产物。
cases.finding: Action pauses delayed caption onset; the agent moved pauses into separate wait steps and recorded again.

cases.prompt: 写一份 Playwright 测试：访问 localhost:3000，填写 Name 和 Email（Alex Demo / alex@example.com），点击 Save，断言页面出现 Contact saved 和 Alex Demo。只写测试，不录视频、不生成动画、不安装依赖。

Write a Playwright test for the local contact form. Fill Alex Demo and alex@example.com, save, and assert the confirmation and submitted name. Deliver only contact.spec.mjs; no video, animation or dependency installation.
